source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

address: 14870 S Pony Express Road - Bluffdale, UT 84065

reading.body:
DataBank SLC6 sits on the Granite Point Campus in Bluffdale, Utah, and publishes 22 MW of IT capacity across 88,250 square feet of technical space. At 10 kW per rack, a common colocation density, 22 MW supports roughly 2,200 racks; at 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, the same power supports roughly 550 racks. The operator publishes no figures for cooling architecture, power redundancy tier, or available versus committed capacity, so headroom for new AI workloads cannot be read from the spec page alone.

No certifications are listed in the published specifications, so no certification-based qualification can be stated for this campus.

Among the 21 data center facilities mapped in Utah, only three, including SLC6, publish a megawatt figure. Those three together account for 39 MW of published IT capacity. SLC6's 22 MW is the largest single published figure among them, giving it the top rank by that measure. That ranking reflects the limits of published data, not a complete picture of Utah's installed capacity, because most mapped facilities in the state publish no power figure at all.
